<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'unsafe-inline';">
    <title>Order handoff</title>
    <style>
        *, *::before, *::after {
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }
        body {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 1rem;
            background-color: #fafafa;
            font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
            color: #18181b;
            overflow-x: auto; /* Last-resort safety net: a diagram wider than the iframe scrolls instead of being crushed to illegibility (layouts normally fit MAX_CONTENT_W). */
            overflow-y: hidden; /* Height is driven by the auto-resize postMessage; never show a vertical scrollbar. */
        }
        svg {
            display: block;
            width: 100%;
            height: auto;
            max-width: 100%;
        }
        .sr-only {
            position: absolute;
            width: 1px;
            height: 1px;
            padding: 0;
            margin: -1px;
            overflow: hidden;
            clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
            white-space: nowrap;
            border: 0;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 568 345" width="100%" height="auto" role="img" aria-label="Order handoff">
    <title>Order handoff</title>
    <desc>Which team handles each step of an order.</desc>
    <defs>
    <marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="6" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
        <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#7c7c86"/>
    </marker>

    <filter id="soft-shadow" x="-8%" y="-8%" width="116%" height="116%">
        <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="1" stdDeviation="2" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.05"/>
    </filter>

    <!-- Chart series fills: patterns rather than color alone, so series stay
         distinguishable in grayscale and for color-blind readers. -->
    <pattern id="hatch-a" width="8" height="8" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" patternTransform="rotate(45)">
        <rect width="8" height="8" fill="#f4f4f5"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="8" stroke="#27272a" stroke-width="3"/>
    </pattern>
    <pattern id="hatch-b" width="8" height="8" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
        <rect width="8" height="8" fill="#f4f4f5"/>
        <circle cx="4" cy="4" r="1.6" fill="#27272a"/>
    </pattern>
    <pattern id="hatch-c" width="8" height="8" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
        <rect width="8" height="8" fill="#f4f4f5"/>
        <path d="M0,0 L8,8 M8,0 L0,8" stroke="#27272a" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    </pattern>

    <style>
        .canvas-bg { fill: #fbfbfc; rx: 12px; }
        .title-text { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; fill: #18181b; text-anchor: middle; }

        /* Node Styles */
        .node-box { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #c9c9d1; stroke-width: 1.5px; rx: 10px; filter: url(#soft-shadow); }
        .node-box.pill { fill: #f6f6f8; stroke: #b7b7c0; stroke-width: 1.5px; rx: 22px; filter: url(#soft-shadow); }
        .node-triangle { fill: #f6f6f8; stroke: #b7b7c0; stroke-width: 1.5px; stroke-linejoin: round; filter: url(#soft-shadow); }

        /* Typography */
        .node-text { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; fill: #2a2a30; text-anchor: middle; dominant-baseline: middle; }
        .badge-meta { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 8.5px; font-weight: 800; fill: #7c7c86; text-anchor: middle; letter-spacing: 0.6px; }

        /* Vectors */
        .flow-path { stroke: #7c7c86; stroke-width: 1.5px; fill: none; marker-end: url(#arrow); stroke-linejoin: round; }

        /* Badges */
        .tag-bg-dark { fill: #24242a; stroke: #18181b; stroke-width: 1px; rx: 11px; }
        .tag-text-light { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; fill: #f6f6f8; text-anchor: middle; dominant-baseline: middle; }
        .tag-bg-light { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #b7b7c0; stroke-width: 1.25px; rx: 11px; }
        .tag-text-dark { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; fill: #24242a; text-anchor: middle; dominant-baseline: middle; }

        /* Swimlane & Journey Map Styles */
        .lane-header { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; fill: #6b6b75; letter-spacing: 0.8px; }
        .lane-divider { stroke: #dddee3; stroke-width: 1px; }
        .curve-line { fill: none; stroke: #24242a; stroke-width: 2.5px; stroke-linecap: round; }
        .curve-dot { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #24242a; stroke-width: 2.5px; r: 6px; }
        .pain-card { fill: #f6f6f8; stroke: #c9c9d1; stroke-width: 1px; rx: 6px; }
        .pain-text { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; fill: #2a2a30; text-anchor: middle; }
        .journey-col-shade { fill: #f4f4f6; }

        /* Chart axes and grid */
        .grid-line { stroke: #e4e4e7; stroke-width: 1px; }
        .axis-line { stroke: #52525b; stroke-width: 1.5px; }
        .axis-label { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px; fill: #52525b; text-anchor: middle; }
        .axis-label-end { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px; fill: #52525b; text-anchor: end; dominant-baseline: middle; }
        .axis-title { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; fill: #27272a; text-anchor: start; }
        .axis-title-center { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; fill: #27272a; text-anchor: middle; }
        .value-label { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; fill: #18181b; text-anchor: middle; }
        .value-label-start { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; fill: #18181b; text-anchor: start; dominant-baseline: middle; }
        .legend-swatch { stroke: #18181b; stroke-width: 1px; }
        .legend-text { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; fill: #27272a; text-anchor: start; dominant-baseline: middle; }

        /* Chart series fills -- pattern, not color alone, differentiates
           series for grayscale/color-blind readers. */
        .bar-0 { fill: #18181b; stroke: #09090b; stroke-width: 1px; }
        .bar-1 { fill: url(#hatch-a); stroke: #27272a; stroke-width: 1px; }
        .bar-2 { fill: url(#hatch-b); stroke: #27272a; stroke-width: 1px; }
        .bar-3 { fill: url(#hatch-c); stroke: #27272a; stroke-width: 1px; }

        /* Line-chart series: dash pattern differentiates without relying on
           color, same rationale as the bar fill patterns above. */
        .series-line { fill: none; stroke: #18181b; stroke-width: 2.5px; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
        .series-line.dash-0 { stroke-dasharray: none; }
        .series-line.dash-1 { stroke-dasharray: 7 4; }
        .series-line.dash-2 { stroke-dasharray: 2 4; }
        .series-line.dash-3 { stroke-dasharray: 9 3 2 3; }
        .data-point { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #18181b; stroke-width: 2px; }
    </style>
</defs>

<text x="461.0" y="293.0" class="node-text"><tspan x="461.0" dy="-0.0">Ship item</tspan></text>

</svg>
    <script>
        function sendHeight() {
            const height = document.documentElement.scrollHeight;
            window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'mcp-iframe-resize', height: height }, '*');
        }
        window.addEventListener('load', sendHeight);
        if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
            new ResizeObserver(sendHeight).observe(document.body);
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
